tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Search for bookable experiences in a specific city with optional category, price, date, audience, accessibility, and duration filtering.

tools.name: search_by_mood
tools.description: Search by emotional intent, mapping moods like romantic, relaxing, foodie, or rainy_day to optimized filters before running a city search.

tools.name: get_last_minute
tools.description: Find experiences starting within the next few hours, sorted by soonest start with countdown text and urgency signals.

tools.name: find_nearby_experiences
tools.description: Find experiences near a geographic location using latitude, longitude, radius, and optional date filtering.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Browse supported cities with optional filtering and result limits.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Quick date-specific availability check for one experience, including party pricing, booking URL, and Ghost Checkout payload metadata.

tools.name: get_experience_details
tools.description: Get detailed availability, pricing, venue, and image information for a specific tickadoo experience using a slug or booking path.

tools.name: compare_experiences
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 experiences side-by-side with winner callouts for best value, highest rated, most popular, and family fit.

tools.name: get_transfer_info
tools.description: Estimate taxi, tube/metro, bus, and train transfers from a city's default airport, station, or port to hotel coordinates.

tools.name: recommend_experiences
tools.description: Get personalized experience recommendations from natural-language preferences such as audience, mood, occasion, budget, weather, and time of day.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: List available experience categories with optional city scoping and per-category counts.

tools.name: whats_on_tonight
tools.description: Find experiences happening tonight in a city, sorted for same-day discovery with timing and urgency context.

tools.name: get_whats_on_this_week
tools.description: Return a day-by-day weekly calendar of what is happening in a city with morning, afternoon, and evening groupings.

tools.name: get_city_guide
tools.description: Return a curated city guide with highlights, price range, category mix, best-for suggestions, and travel-planning context.

tools.name: get_family_day
tools.description: Build a family day with a morning activity, lunch tip, afternoon attraction, and optional evening stop using age-aware filtering and geographic clustering.

tools.name: plan_itinerary
tools.description: Plan a multi-day itinerary with morning, afternoon, and evening slots, balancing geography, category variety, and budget.

name: io.github.tickadoo/tickadoo-mcp
title: tickadoo — Experiences & Events
description: Discover and book theatre, shows, events and experiences in 700+ cities worldwide.
